name: 바람방울
model: Original procedural Three.js geometry created for this project, informed by the wind-droplet concept shown in this conversation. No downloaded character model is used for this mascot.
scope: Explicit preview only: player, policy guides, booth volunteers and locally rendered remote avatars. Ordinary students and seated students keep the existing Kenney rig. The normal URL retains human characters.
brand: Existing user-provided assets/sumgyeol_symbol_blue.png on the backpack, kept in its original aspect ratio. Brand rights remain separate from third-party asset licenses.
implementation: Static coloured parts merged into one mesh; geometry and materials shared across mascot instances. Animation never translates the collision root. Booth mascot stands on a 0.32m platform so the counter does not hide its face.
